# Rejig Labs — Full Reference

> AI that works inside your business. Rejig Labs is an AI implementation partner based in Phuket, Thailand. We find where AI saves your business time and money, build it into the tools you already use, and train your team to run it.

**What we are:** An AI implementation partner in Thailand, founded and led by Rut Adikari (Mr. RT). Most consultants hand over a strategy deck and leave; we stay and build it. We only recommend what we can actually build and deploy ourselves.

**Location:** Phuket, Thailand (also Bangkok), working remotely worldwide.
**Languages:** English, Thai (ไทย), Russian (Русский).

## How We Work — Three Steps

**1. Identify.** We get under the hood of your business. We map your acquisition, delivery, and support workflows to find where time is bleeding out, where bottlenecks hide, and where AI can make the biggest impact. No guesswork, just the opportunities actually worth building. Output: a full AI roadmap (90-day plan, prioritised integrations, tool recommendations, ROI estimates) in 2–4 weeks. Three core flows are audited: acquisition, delivery, and support.

**2. Develop.** With the roadmap locked, we build fast. Custom AI workflows designed around your existing tools and processes. No rip-and-replace. Everything integrates into how your team already works, so it delivers value from the first week.

**3. Adopt.** AI only works if your team actually uses it. We embed alongside your people, running training, refining workflows, and adjusting until the new systems feel like second nature. When we step back, it's not a project anymore. It's just how things run.

**Headline numbers:** 40%+ average time saved on manual workflows · 2–4 weeks to a full AI roadmap · implementation-first (we build, not just advise).

## Web3 / Blockchain Growth (specialty service)

A full-stack growth consultancy for Web3, DeFi, NFT, AI, and blockchain projects with product-market fit. Founder-led, execution-obsessed, Web3-native. We build custom frameworks, not templates. Offerings: founder-led marketing, project partnerships, event explorations, advertisement strategy, brand strategy & positioning, a Web3 ads engine, paid + organic SEO, KOL & thought-leader campaigns, and AI-powered workflows. Success is tracked on tangible KPIs: user acquisition, conversion rates, TVL growth, community size, and ROI on ad spend, with live dashboards and weekly reports.

## Case Studies (real client results)

### BoBe — AI Trading Platform
**Headline:** From a $3K/month content team to a fully autonomous system.
BoBe's content team cost $2,000–3,000/month and took 1–2 days per batch. We built an autonomous system that generates 14 pieces of content in seconds for under $30/month, each piece costing less than $1 to generate.
- Running cost: under $30/month · 14 posts per run · 3 days build time.
- Testimonial: "Working with RT gave us something we didn't expect: actual clarity on where AI could help us. Not theory. A real plan we could execute. The implementation saved us hours every week from day one." — Denis Kurilchik, CEO, BoBe.

### Ducky Cutz, Barbershop (Phuket)
**Headline:** A 24/7 AI front desk that books hands-free.
A busy Phuket Town barbershop lost bookings whenever the chairs were full or the shop was closed. We built an AI front desk that answers every call, text, and LINE message in Thai, English, or Russian and books straight into the calendar, day or night, with no staff time needed.
- 300+ calls handled per month · ~80% booked hands-free · answered 24/7.
- Testimonial: "We used to lose bookings every time the phone rang mid-cut. Rejig built us an AI front desk that answers in Thai, English and Russian, takes the booking and never puts a customer on hold. It runs on its own now and the calendar fills itself across all our branches." (Ella N., Owner, Ducky Cutz).

### ANRCF, Green Charity Golf Tournament (Thailand)
**Headline:** Thailand's first Green Charity Golf Tournament, run end to end in three languages.
For Thailand's first Green Charity Golf Tournament, Rejig Labs ran the whole digital operation end to end: a trilingual registration site, the sign-up funnel, print and brand collateral, and sponsor outreach.
- 35 teams registered · 21 sponsors secured · 3 languages (EN/TH/RU) · 4 workstreams delivered.
- Testimonial: "We needed a whole event operation: the website, registrations, sponsors and print, all in three languages. Rejig Labs delivered every piece and ran it like a team many times its size. They became a real partner, credited on the tournament banner alongside our sponsors." (Samran Sinthong, VP & Founder, ANRCF).

## FAQ

**How is Rejig Labs different from AI consultants?**
Most consultants hand you a strategy deck and leave. Rejig Labs builds what it recommends, deploys it, and stays until your team runs it. Every project is led by the founder, Rut Adikari (Mr. RT).

**How do I know if we're ready?**
If your team repeats the same manual work every week (data entry, follow-ups, reports, scheduling, content), you're ready. You don't need clean data or a tech team. The audit shows where to start.

**What happens after the audit?**
You get a written plan: a 90-day roadmap, the integrations to build first, tool choices and expected ROI. Run it yourself, or have Rejig Labs build it.

**How much of our team's time will this take?**
A few hours of calls and walkthroughs during the audit. Rejig Labs handles the build. Your team joins for handover and training.

**We tried AI before and it didn't stick. Why is this different?**
Most AI projects fail at integration, not technology. Rejig Labs fits the tools to how your team works, gets people on board, and builds systems they use every day.

**We don't have a tech team. Can we still do this?**
Yes. Most Rejig Labs clients don't. You know your business; Rejig Labs handles everything technical.

**Who founded Rejig Labs?**
Rut Adikari, known to clients as Mr. RT. Rut leads every project personally, from the first call to handover. More: https://rejiglabs.com/about/

**Where is Rejig Labs based?**
Phuket and Bangkok, Thailand, working with clients worldwide in English, Thai and Russian.

**Why "Rejig" Labs?**
"Rejig" means to reorganize or rethink. We take your existing strategies and systems and reorganize them for maximum performance and growth.
